examples.text: tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā itthisahassānaṃ ekā'y'eva sā itthī hoti yā maṃ tena samayena paccupaṭṭhāti, khattiyānī vā velāmikā vā.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso ānanda, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte acche vā udakapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno upādāya passeyya, no anupādāya.
itthī'pi hi ekacciyā, seyyā posa janādhipa, medhāvinī sīlavatī, sassudevā patibbatā.
331, 353. itthiyaṃ bhāsitapum'itthī pumā'va ce.

evaṃ vutte ahetū appaccayā purisassa saññā uppajjanti'pi nirujjhanti'pi. yasmiṃ samaye uppajjanti, saññī tasmiṃ samaye hoti. yasmiṃ samaye nirujjhanti, asaññī tasmiṃ samaye hotī'ti. itth'eke abhisaññānirodhaṃ paññapenti.
yesaṃ kesañci bhavasaṃyojanaṃ appahīnaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā saupaghātā saupāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā'ti, iti vadaṃ itth'eke apasādeti.

13605.meaning1: here this; in this regard this

examples.text: cakkhu aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi. rūpā aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino. itth'etaṃ dvayaṃ calañ'c'eva byathañ'ca aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi. cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi.
phuṭṭho, bhikkhave, vedeti, phuṭṭho ceteti, phuṭṭho sañjānāti. itth'ete'pi dhammā calā c'eva byathā ca aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino.

13607.grammar: ind, adv, nt nom sg of ima

examples.text: purimā, bhikkhave, koṭi na paññāyati avijjāya, ito pubbe avijjā n'āhosi, atha pacchā samabhavī'ti. evañ'c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati, atha ca pana paññāyati, idappaccayā avijjā'ti
saññā kho, poṭṭhapāda, paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, pacchā ñāṇaṃ, saññ'uppādā ca pana ñāṇ'uppādo hoti. so evaṃ pajānāti, idappaccayā

evam'etaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, hoti yesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ tādisā sabrahmacārino anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsakā. idañ'ca pana me āyasmato sāriputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttan'ti.
ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettika-sambhavo odanakummāsa-upacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti

13609.meaning1: such and such; this and that

examples.text: ahaṃ khvajja idañ'c'idañ'ca khādanīyaṃ khādiṃ, idañ'c'idañ'ca bhojanīyaṃ bhuñjiṃ, sve dān'āhaṃ idañ'c'idañ'ca khādanīyaṃ khādissāmi, idaṃ c'idañ'ca bhojanīyaṃ bhuñjissāmī'ti.

sīghaṃ dāruādīni āharathā'ti gahapatike vatvā gāmamajjhe vuttapakāraṃ gehaṃ kārāpetvā gāmasatato paṇṇākāraṃ āharāpetvā janapadaseṭṭhino santikā dhītaraṃ ānetvā maṅgalaṃ katvā seṭṭhissa sāsanaṃ pahiṇi, idañ'c'idañ'ca mayā katan'ti.
idaṃ niccaṃ, idaṃ dhuvaṃ, idaṃ sassataṃ, idaṃ kevalaṃ, idaṃ acavanadhammaṃ, idañ'hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, ito ca pan'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ n'atthī'ti
idañ'hi taṃ jetavanaṃ, isisaṅghanisevitaṃ, āvutthaṃ dhammarājena, pītisañjananaṃ mama.

13611.meaning2: having its foundation on this; i.e. causally connected
13611.commentary: (SNa) idappaccayatā'ti imesaṃ jarāmaraṇ'ādīnaṃ paccayā idappaccayā, idappaccayā'va idappaccayatā.

examples.text: ālayarāmā kho pan'āyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālayasammuditā. ālayarāmā kho pan'āyaṃ pajā ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ, idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppādo.
avijjāya nivuto loko'ti. avijjā'ti… idappaccayatā-paṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu aññāṇaṃ

13612.meaning1: arising together from a specific cause
13612.meaning2: arising together from a specific cause
13612.commentary: (MNa) idappaccayatā-paṭiccasamuppādo'ti imesaṃ paccayā idappaccayā, idappaccayā eva idappaccayatā, idappaccayatā ca sā paṭiccasamuppādo cā'ti idappaccayatā-paṭiccasamuppādo. saṅkhār'ādipaccayānam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: ālayarāmāya kho pana pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ, idappaccayatā-paṭiccasamuppādo. idam'pi kho ṭhānaṃ duddasaṃ, yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.

13613.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of idappaccaya
13613.meaning1: due to this; on account of this; because of this

examples.text: saññā kho, poṭṭhapāda, paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, pacchā ñāṇaṃ, saññ'uppādā ca pana ñāṇ'uppādo hoti. so evaṃ pajānāti, idappaccayā
purimā, bhikkhave, koṭi na paññāyati avijjāya, ito pubbe avijjā n'āhosi, atha pacchā samabhavī'ti. evañ'c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati, atha ca pana paññāyati, idappaccayā avijjā'ti

13615.meaning1: being for this reason alone; for its one sake
13615.commentary: (THa) idamatthikan'ti idaṃ payojan'atthaṃ satthārā vuttapayojan'atthaṃ yāva'd'eva sīt'ādi-paṭighātan'atthañ'c'eva hirīkopīnapaṭicchādan'atthañ'cā'ti attho. etena kāyaparihāriyaṃ cīvaraṃ tattha itar'ītara-santosañ'ca vadati.

examples.text: kappiyaṃ taṃ ce chādeti, cīvaraṃ idam'atthikaṃ, alaṃ phāsuvihārāya, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno.

13616.meaning1: being for this reason alone; for its one sake
13616.construction:
idaṃ + attha + ī + tā
idamatthī + tā
13616.commentary: (ANa) idam'atthitan'ti imāya kalyāṇāya paṭipattiyā attho etassā'ti idam'atthī, idam'atthino bhāvo idam'atthitā. taṃ idam'atthitaṃ'y'eva nissāya, na aññaṃ kiñci lok'āmisan'ti attho.

examples.text: mandattā momūhattā āraññiko hoti, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato āraññiko hoti, ummādā cittakkhepā āraññiko hoti, vaṇṇitaṃ buddhehi buddhasāvakehīti āraññiko hoti, appicchataṃ'y'eva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃ'y'eva nissāya sallekhaṃ'y'eva nissāya pavivekaṃ'y'eva nissāya idam'atthitaṃ'y'eva nissāya āraññiko hoti.

13617.meaning1: not giving this up; not abandoning this

examples.text: yo ca abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño, yo ca suddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carantaṃ amūlakena abrahmacariyena anuddhaṃseti, yo c'āyaṃ evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi, n'atthi kāmesu doso'ti, so tāya kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjati. ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo āpāyikā nerayikā idam'appahāyā'ti.

13618.meaning1: this is his; this of that

examples.text: sīho'ti, kho bhikkhave, tathāgatass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa. yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato parisāya dhammaṃ deseti, idam'assa hoti sīhanādasmiṃ.
idam'assa paṭhamaṃ ñāṇaṃ adhigataṃ hoti ariyaṃ lok'uttaraṃ asādhāraṇaṃ puthujjanehi.
idam'avoca bhagavā. attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun'ti.
idam'avoc'āyasmā sāriputto. attamano āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandī'ti.

13621.meaning1: caused to take this; persuaded to accept this
13621.commentary: (SNa) ko nu taṃ idam'ādapayī'ti ko nu mandabuddhi bālo taṃ evaṃ gāhāpesi?

examples.text: kiṃ nu jātiṃ na rocesi, jāto kāmāni bhuñjati, ko nu taṃ idam'ādapayi, jātiṃ mā roca bhikkhunī'ti.
iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttan'ti.
idam'etaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ, pitu sakkassa kamm'ante sītāya jambucchāyāya nisinno…

13623.meaning1: here in this case; in this instance

examples.text: idam'ettha apakaḍḍheyya, evaṃ taṃ parisuddhataraṃ assā'ti, iti h'etaṃ na passati. idam'ettha upakaḍḍheyya, evaṃ taṃ paripūraṃ assā'ti, iti h'etaṃ na passati. idaṃ vuccati cunda, passaṃ na passatī'ti.
ye diṭṭhim'uggayha vivādayanti, idam'eva saccan'ti ca vādayanti, te tvaṃ vadassū na hi te'dha atthi, vādamhi jāte paṭisenikattā.
ye kec'ime diṭṭhiparibbasānā, idam'eva saccan'ti vivādayanti, sabb'eva te nindam'anvānayanti, atho pasaṃsam'pi labhanti tattha.

13625.meaning1: just this; this very; this exact

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci vittaṃ idha vā huraṃ vā, saggesu vā yaṃ ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, na no samaṃ atthi tathāgatena, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
kiñ'c'āpi so kamma karoti pāpakaṃ, kāyena vācā uda cetasā vā, abhabba so tassa paṭicchadāya, abhabbatā diṭṭhapadassa vuttā, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

13626.meaning1: it seems to me; I presume

examples.text: iti yathā yathā naṃ tesu tesu janapadesu sañjānanti, idaṃ kira me āyasmanto sandhāya voharantī'ti, tathā tathā voharati aparāmasaṃ.

13627.meaning1: this (is an offence) for that (person); (or) this because of that
13627.meaning2: because of that; this on account of that; lit. this in that
13627.commentary: (KVa) idaṃ tasmiṃ pācittiyan'ti yo pana upajjhāyo hutvā upasampādeti, tasmiṃ'y'eva puggale idaṃ pācittiyaṃ veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādeyya, so ca puggalo anupasampanno te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, idaṃ tasmiṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
tassa te, āvuso, alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi karosī'ti, idaṃ tasmiṃ mohanake, pācittiyaṃ.

13628.grammar: pron, nt nom sg of ima

examples.text: vārijo'va thale khitto, okam'okata'ubbhato, pariphandat'idaṃ cittaṃ, māradheyyaṃ pahātave.
diṭṭhā'pi sutā'pi te janā, yesaṃ nāmam'idaṃ pavuccati, nāmaṃ yev'āvasissati, akkheyyaṃ petassa jantuno.

13629.grammar: pron, nt acc sg of ima

examples.text: saṃyojanāni etāni, pajahitvāna bhikkhunī, orambhā'gamanīyāni, na'y'idaṃ punarehisi.

13631.meaning1: clinging to the idea that 'this is the truth'
13631.commentary: (DNa) idaṃsacc'ābhiniveso'ti idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti evaṃ pavatto diṭṭh'ābhiniveso.

examples.text: cattāro ganthā, abhijjhā kāyagantho, byāpādo kāyagantho, sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho, idaṃsacc'ābhiniveso kāyagantho.

tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno āyasmā ca ānando avāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihāre āhiṇḍanti, abhikkamath'āyasmanto, abhikkamath'āyasmanto! idān'āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato sammukhā sīhanādaṃ nadissatī'ti.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno evam'āha, kiṃ nu kho tumhe āyasmanto atibāḷhaṃ mayi byāvaṭā yāva idān'āhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattissāmī'ti.
kathañ'hi no siyā, bhante! idān'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisitto'ti.
idāni, bhante, deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā
añña'd'atthu, ayaṃ varāko idāni marissati, yaṃ yadeva hi ayaṃ padaṃ nikkhipati, tena tena santike maraṇassa hotī'ti taṃ jano karuṇāyati.
arūpa dūraṅ'gama ekacāri, na te karissaṃ vacanaṃ idāni'haṃ, dukkhā hi kāmā kaṭukā mahabbhayā, nibbānam'ev'ābhimano carissaṃ.

13638.meaning1: just now; right now; only now

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu anvaddhamāsaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, idān'eva kho ahaṃ jānāmi, ayam'pi kira dhammo sutt'āgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī'ti.
idān'eva pana mayaṃ, āvuso, āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ evaṃ ājānāma, usmā āyuṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhatī'ti. yathā kathaṃ pan'āvuso, imassa bhāsitassa attho daṭṭhabbo'ti?
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, idaṃ, bhante, kapilavatthu iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca bāhujaññaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ sambādhabyūhaṃ.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, ayaṃ nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā'ti? evaṃ, bhante, ayaṃ nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā'ti.
atha kho cittassa gahapatino etadahosi, yo kho imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavako bhikkhu tass'āyaṃ evarūpo iddh'ānubhāvo'ti.

13644.commentary: (MNa) iddh'ānubhāvā'ti yathākāmaṃ kattabbabhāvato, vasībhāvo'y'eva hi ettha iddhī'ti ca ānubhāvo'ti ca adhippeto.

examples.text: evañ'hi te, bhikkhave, paṭhamā migajātā na parimucciṃsu nevāpikassa iddh'ānubhāvā.

13645.meaning1: performance of supernormal ability; display of psychic power

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā addasa uttaro māṇavo bhagavato kos'ohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.

atha kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsiṃ, ettāvatā brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca saddañ'ca me sossanti, na ca maṃ dakkhantī'ti. antarahito imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsiṃ.

13646.meaning1: psychic power; psychic potency; supernormal ability

examples.text: haṃs'ādiccapathe yanti, ākāse yanti iddhiyā, nīyanti dhīrā lokamhā, jetvā māraṃ savāhiniṃ.
mama saṅkappam'aññāya, satthā loke anuttaro, manomayena kāyena, iddhiyā upasaṅkami.
rājā, ānanda, mahāsudassano sattahi ratanehi samannāgato ahosi catūhi ca iddhīhi.
āmis'iddhi ca dhamm'iddhi ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve iddhiyo. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ iddhīnaṃ yadidaṃ dhamm'iddhī'ti.

13650.commentary: (PMa) iddhipaṭilābhāyā'ti parihīnānaṃ vā iddhīnaṃ vīriy'ārambhavasena puna lābhāya, upasaggavasena vā padaṃ vaḍḍhitaṃ. (VISMa) iddhipaṭilābhāyā'ti iddhiyā punappunaṃ labhamānāya, bahulīkaraṇāyā'ti attho.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, iddhipādo? yo so, bhikkhave, maggo yā paṭipadā iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya saṃvattati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, iddhipādo.

13651.meaning1: attained psychic power; possessing supernormal ability

examples.text: tevijjā iddhipattā ca, cetopariyāyakovidā, khīṇ'āsavā arahanto, bahū buddhassa sāvakā'ti.

13652.meaning1: partial psychic power; limited supernormal ability; (comm) three paths and fruits
13652.commentary: (SNa) piddhipadesan'ti tayo ca magge tīṇi ca phalāni. (SNt) iddhipadesan'ti iddhiyā ekadesaṃ. ko pana so'ti āha, tayo ca magge tīṇi ca phalānī'ti.

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, anāgatam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā iddhipadesaṃ abhinipphādessanti sabbe te catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā.

13654.meaning2: mastery of or possession of supernormal power

examples.text: ime kho, bho, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro iddhipādā paññattā iddhipahutāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivikubbanatāya.

13655.meaning1: miracle of psychic power; wonder of supernormal ability
13655.commentary: (ANa) iddhipāṭihāriyan'ti ijjhanavasena iddhi, paṭiharaṇavasena pāṭihāriyaṃ, iddhi'y'eva pāṭihāriyaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ.

examples.text: imaṃ kho ahaṃ, kevaṭṭa, iddhipāṭihāriye ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno iddhipāṭihāriyena aṭṭīyāmi harāyāmi jigucchāmi
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ mahakaṃ etadavoca, sādhu me, bhante, ayyo mahako uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetū'ti.

13656.meaning1: discussion about the miracle of psychic power

13657.meaning1: basis for success; road to power; basis for spiritual power
13657.commentary: (DNa) iddhipādā'ti ettha ijjhan'aṭṭhena iddhi, patiṭṭhān'aṭṭhena pādā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: cittasmiṃ vasībhūt'āmhi, iddhipādā subhāvitā, sabbabandhanamutt'āmhi, na taṃ bhāyāmi āvuso'ti.
yassa kassaci, ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā so ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā
pubb'eva me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato etadahosi, ko nu kho hetu, ko paccayo iddhipādabhāvanāyā'ti?

13659.meaning1: leading to the development of psychic power

examples.text: iddhiṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi iddhipādañ'ca iddhipādabhāvanañ'ca iddhipādabhāvanāgāminiñ'ca paṭipadaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

13660.meaningLit: connected with the basis for success

13661.meaningLit: discourse on the basis for spiritual power

13662.meaningLit: discourse on the basis for spiritual power

13664.commentary: (PM) katamāni dasa iddhibalāni? adhiṭṭhānā iddhi, vikubbanā iddhi, manomayā iddhi, ñāṇavipphārā iddhi, samādhivipphārā iddhi, ariyā iddhi, kammavipākajā iddhi, puññavato iddhi, vijjāmayā iddhi, tattha tattha sammā payogappaccayā ijjhan'aṭṭhena iddhi, imāni dasa iddhibalāni.

examples.text: yo vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ, pād'aṅguṭṭhena kampayi, iddhibalen'upatthaddho, saṃvejesi ca devatā.
yattha eke vihaññanti, āruhantā siluccayaṃ, tassa buddhassa dāy'ādo, sampajāno patissato, iddhibalen'upatthaddho, kassapo abhirūhati.

13665.meaning1: supported by psychic power; helped by psychic ability

examples.text: yo vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ, pād'aṅguṭṭhena kampayi, iddhibalen'upatthaddho, saṃvejesi ca devatā.
yattha eke vihaññanti, āruhantā siluccayaṃ, tassa buddhassa dāy'ādo, sampajāno patissato, iddhibalen'upatthaddho, kassapo abhirūhati.

13667.meaning1: who has psychic powers; possessing supernormal ability

examples.text: mahantasmiṃ kho pana lokasannivāse santi samaṇabrāhmaṇā iddhimanto dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduno. te dūrato'pi passanti, āsannā'pi na dissanti, cetasā'pi cittaṃ pajānanti.
bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, bhante, rohitasso nāma isi ahosiṃ bhojaputto iddhimā vehāsaṅ'gamo.

13668.meaning1: truly they are supernormal!; they must have psychic powers!

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, nevāpikassa ca nevāpikaparisāya ca etadahosi, saṭhāssunām'ime tatiyā migajātā ketabino, iddhimantāssunām'ime tatiyā migajātā parajanā, imañ'ca nāma nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ paribhuñjanti, na ca nesaṃ jānāma āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā.
devatā'pi kho santi iddhimantiniyo dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduniyo. tā dūrato'pi passanti, āsannā'pi na dissanti, cetasā'pi cittaṃ jānanti.

13670.commentary: (NIDD1a) devatā'pi kho santi iddhimantiniyo'ti devatā'pi evaṃ saṃvijjanti ijjhanapabhāvavantiniyo.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ iddhimantīnaṃ yadidaṃ uppalavaṇṇā.

13671.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of iddhi

examples.text: haṃs'ādiccapathe yanti, ākāse yanti iddhiyā, nīyanti dhīrā lokamhā, jetvā māraṃ savāhiniṃ.
atha kho maṃ, āvuso, bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca, moggallāna, moggallāna, mā, brāhmaṇa, ariyaṃ tuṇhībhāvaṃ pamādo, ariye tuṇhībhāve cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi

13672.meaning1: gaining psychic power; acquiring supernormal ability
13672.commentary: (PMa) iddhilābhāyā'ti attano santāne pātubhāvavasena iddhīnaṃ lābhāya. (VISMa) iddhilābhāyā'ti iddhiyā adhigamāya.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, iddhipādo? yo so, bhikkhave, maggo yā paṭipadā iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya saṃvattati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, iddhipādo.

13674.meaning2: transformation effected by supernormal power; display of magic

13675.commentary: (DNa) iddhivikubbanatāyā'ti iddhivikubbanabhāvāya, nānappakārato katvā dassan'atthāya. (PMa) iddhivikubbanatāyā'ti iddhiyā vividhakaraṇabhāvāya. (DNt) iddhivikubbanatāyā'ti vikubban'iddhiyā vividharūpakaraṇāya. ten'āha nānappakārato katvā dassan'atthāyā'ti. (VISMa) iddhivikubbanatāyā'ti iddhiyā vividharūpakāraṇāya, vikubban'iddhiyā'ti attho.

examples.text: ime kho, bho, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro iddhipādā paññattā iddhipahutāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivikubbanatāya.
so tathābhāvitena cittena parisuddhena pariyodātena iddhividhañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti. so anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti.

13677.meaning1: teaching about the types of supernormal ability

13678.meaningLit: discourse on the various kinds of psychic power

13679.meaning1: kinds of psychic power; types of supernormal ability

examples.text: so sace ākaṅkhati, anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ, eko'pi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ, bahudhā'pi hutvā eko assaṃ, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ

13681.commentary: (DNa) iddhivisavitāyā'ti iddhivipajjanabhāvāya, punappunaṃ āsevanavasena ciṇṇavasitāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (PMa) iddhivisavitāyā'ti vividhaṃ visesaṃ savati janeti pavattetī'ti visavī, vividhaṃ savanaṃ vā assa atthī'ti visavī, tassa bhāvo visavitā. tassā visavitāya, iddhiyā vividha-visesa-pavattana-bhāvāyā'ti attho. (DNt) iddhivisavitāyā'ti iddhiyā nipphādane yogyabhāvāya. anek'atthattā hi dhātūnaṃ yogyattho vi-pubbo su-saddo, visavanaṃ vā pajjanaṃ visavitā, tattha kāmakāritā visavitā. (VISMa) iddhivisavitāyā'ti iddhiyā vividhānisaṃsapasavanāya.

examples.text: ime kho, bho, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro iddhipādā paññattā iddhipahutāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivikubbanatāya.

13683.meaning1: what here?; what then?; here then

examples.text: idha no, āvuso, ko viseso, ko adhippayāso, kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā, yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ, anusāsaniyā vā anusāsanin'ti?
idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhāvitakāyo hoti abhāvitasīlo abhāvitacitto abhāvitapañño paritto app'ātumo appadukkhavihārī.

13685.meaning1: here or there; (comm) in this world or the next
13685.commentary: (SNa) idha vā huraṃ vā'ti idhaloke vā paraloke vā.

examples.text: appam'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca pahāya mohaṃ, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, anupādiyāno idha vā huraṃ vā, sa bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.
yass'ūbhay'ante paṇidh'īdha n'atthi, bhav'ābhavāya idha vā huraṃ vā, nivesanā tassa na santi keci, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ.

13686.meaning2: here, in this world or existence

examples.text: idha socati pecca socati, pāpakārī ubhay'attha socati, so socati so vihaññati, disvā kammakiliṭṭham'attano.
na hi verena verāni, sammant'īdha kudācanaṃ, averena ca sammanti, esa dhammo sanantano.

13687.meaning1: here; in this regard; in this case

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāy'ānupassī viharati

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.

13688.meaning1: (comm) in this teaching; here in this doctrine

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ hāretā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti
veditvā so sucaritassa phalaṃ, uṇhīsasīsattam'idh'ajjhagamā, byākaṃsu byañjananimittadharā, pubbaṅ'gamo bahujanaṃ hessati.

13690.commentary: (SNa) taṃ te dhammaṃ idh'aññāyā'ti te therā taṃ dhammaṃ idha tumhākaṃ sāsane jānitvā.

examples.text: yattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, taṃ te dhammaṃ idh'aññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan'ti.

13691.meaning1: here there are; here there is

examples.text: vedāni viceyya kevalāni, samaṇānaṃ yān'idh'atthi brāhmaṇānaṃ, sabbavedanāsu vītarāgo, sabbaṃ vedam'aticca vedagū so.
na mānakāmassa damo idh'atthi, na monam'atthi asamāhitassa, eko araññe viharaṃ pamatto, na maccudheyyassa tareyya pāran'ti.

13692.commentary: (MNa) idham'anusikkhato'ti imasmiṃ sāsane sikkhantassa te tayo'pi kilesā antarāyakarā honti.

examples.text: etth'ete pāpakā akusalā mānasā abhijjhā'pi byāpādā'pi sārambhā'pi saṃvattanti. t'eva ariyasāvakassa idha'm'anusikkhato antarāyāya sambhavanti.

idhalokam'pi nissāya jhāyati, paralokam'pi nissāya jhāyati, yam'p'idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam'pi nissāya jhāyati. evaṃ kho, sandha, purisakhaḷuṅkajhāyitaṃ hoti.
catūhi kho, visākhe, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsa loko āraddho hoti. katamehi catūhi?

13694.meaning1: thoughts about this world; speculation about the present life

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhito hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti. sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu idhalokacintāya pasuto hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti. sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paralokacintāya pasuto hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti.
tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na idhalokaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me idhalokanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

13696.meaning1: recognition of this world; perception of this world (in); concept of the present life

examples.text: idha, sandha, bhadrassa puris'ājānīyassa… idhaloke idhalokasaññā vibhūtā hoti, paraloke paralokasaññā vibhūtā hoti, yam'p'idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tatrā'pi saññā vibhūtā hoti.

13697.meaning1: aware of this world; percipient of this world (in)

examples.text: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭil… na n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatane n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-saññī assa, na idhaloke idhalokasaññī assa, na paraloke paralokasaññī assa, saññī ca pana assā'ti?

13698.meaning1: here could be; there might be

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, kumāra, idh'assa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā kūṭ'āgāraṃ ullitt'āvalittaṃ nivātaṃ phusit'aggaḷaṃ pihitavātapānaṃ.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso pāṇ'ātipātī adinn'ādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko.

13699.meaning1: suppose there were; imagine there was

examples.text: sakkā, bhikkhave'ti bhagavā avoca. idh'assu, bhikkhave, cattāro sāvakā vassasat'āyukā vassasatajīvino. te divase divase kappasatasahassaṃ kappasatasahassaṃ anussareyyuṃ.
